hadith:
Invoking Allah for Rain (Istisqaa) - Narrated `Abdullah bin Zaid Al-Ansari:

The Prophet (ﷺ) went out towards the Musalla in order to offer the Istisqa' prayer and when he intended to invoke (Allah) or started invoking, he faced the Qibla and turned his cloak inside out.
message: Remembering Allah's attributes like Al Mudhil reminds us of the importance of obedience and humility before Him. Following Satan leads to disgrace, while worshipping Allah alone brings elevation and peace. Let this be a call to reflect on our choices and align ourselves with the Straight Path.
name:
Al Mudhil - المُذِلُّ - The Humiliator

Al Mudhil refers to Allah's attribute of causing disgrace or humiliation to those who oppose His commands or reject His guidance. This name emphasizes the power of Allah to elevate or debase individuals based on their actions and faith. It serves as a reminder of the consequences of turning away from righteousness and the importance of adhering to divine guidance.
verse:
Ya-Sin - Ya Sin - 36:60-61

Did I not command you, O  Children of Adam, not to follow Satan, for he is truly your sworn enemy, but to worship Me ˹alone˺? This is the Straight Path.
